acceptance_criteria: AC-1: run on a stub engineer that exits 0 and closes the relay returns 0, prints the section 2.4 report object, leaves no child process
AC-2: run --timeout 1 on a sleeping stub returns 1, record failed/timeout, stub PID dead
AC-3: heartbeat timeout kills a stub that stops writing engineer.log and records heartbeat_timeout
AC-4: verify executes object-form validation_plan entries with shell=False, records exit codes, fails on non-zero; string entries recorded skipped_prose
AC-5: verify fails on a worktree with uncommitted changes
AC-6: retry_count increments on resume; after retry_limit dead resumes status reports failed
AC-7: gov_session_transfer validate accepts both validation_plan item forms and rejects an object missing argv or with non-list argv
AC-8: tests/test_gov_po_3_ci_privacy_gate_baseline.py green after moving the privacy-gate call
AC-9: state dir default under <worktrees-dir>/.state/; legacy temp-dir record still listed by status
AC-10: git diff --check clean; privacy gate 0 new findings; local_relay.py and relay/*.json untouched

baseline.authority: docs/design/GOV_ORCH_1_SYNCHRONOUS_RUN_AND_ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFY.md (DRAFT -- FOR PRODUCT OWNER FREEZE); GOV_PO_3_APPROVED_MOVEMENT_ORCHESTRATION.md (FROZEN) for everything the contract does not amend
baseline.sequencing: GOV.ORCH.1 first; GOV.ORCH.2 and GOV.ORCH.3 after it merges (both touch scripts/orchestrator.py)

invariants: run reuses start's code path; no duplicated dispatch logic
Task content never enters an argv element
Engineer's SESSION_CLOSE validation strings are non-authoritative; the orchestrator's own verify run is the evidence
Every subprocess is an argv list with shell=False
report.merge_gate: PO review of diff and orchestrator-run tests; no self-merge. Privacy gate at push; git diff --check.
report.objective: Implement GOV.ORCH.1: add `run` (dispatch, wait, verify, report in one foreground call) and `verify` subcommands to scripts/orchestrator.py, orchestrator-side execution of object-form validation_plan entries in a new scripts/orchestrator_verify.py that also hosts the privacy-gate call the engineer hook uses, retry_count accounting on resume, failure_reason/exit_code on the record, the state-dir default under <worktrees-dir>/.state/, and the additive validation_plan item union in scripts/gov_session_transfer.py.
output_contract: Implementation exactly as docs/design/GOV_ORCH_1_SYNCHRONOUS_RUN_AND_ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFY.md sections Design/Scope specify
Tests named in the contract, green in a foreground run
SESSION_CLOSE on the relay with exact changed files, test results, blockers and commit state

recommended_reasoning.reason: Deterministic implementation against a written contract; lifecycle code must be right first pass, so not Haiku; no architecture decision left open, so not extended thinking.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law
Read the named contract document fully; read only the files it lists under Scope In plus their direct tests
Smallest diff that satisfies every acceptance criterion; no scope expansion
Run the validation plan in the foreground and wait for real results before SESSION_CLOSE
risks: Process-lifecycle code (wait/kill/heartbeat) that passes on Linux but hangs on Windows: keep _kill_pid semantics and guard signal usage
Breaking the existing test_start_cli_* stub-claude tests by changing argv
Turning validation_plan object entries into a schema change that rejects old relay files
validation_plan: targeted tests: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_orchestrator_verify.py tests/test_gov_session_transfer.py tests/test_gov_po_3_ci_privacy_gate_baseline.py tests/test_local_relay_protocol.py
